product.title: Truckee River: Boca to Floriston Run (Class III Whitewater)

description.text: Raft the Truckee River on a guided Class III whitewater run from Boca to Floriston Gorge. Begin with mellow rapids through Tahoe National Forest scenery, then build to intermediate rapids with optional swimming stops in natural pools on warm days.

highlights: Class III whitewater run on the Truckee River
Guides assist from put-in through Floriston Gorge
PFD, helmet, and transport back to meeting point included
Wetsuits and splash jackets provided in cold weather
Scenic forest canyon setting near Lake Tahoe

start.description: Meet at Truckee River Put-In, 10550 Stampede Meadows Rd, Truckee, CA 96161. Plan to carpool when parking is limited.

end.description: Shuttle returns you to the Truckee River meeting point after the run.

product.itinerarySummary: Raft the Truckee River on a guided Class III whitewater run from Boca to Floriston Gorge.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Tahoe (California)
itineraryItems.description: Launch on the Truckee River for a guided rafting run through forest canyon scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Truckee
itineraryItems.description: Finish in Floriston Gorge with intermediate Class III rapids.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Truckee River: Boca to Floriston Run (Class III Whitewater)?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 3 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at Lake Tahoe?
faqs.answer: Meet at Truckee River Put-In, 10550 Stampede Meadows Rd, Truckee, CA 96161. Plan to carpool when parking is limited.
